description: What one Blender system can pass to another [skills/scene-simulation/references/material-playbooks.en.md section 7]. Each entry: a channel, the systems (schemas/solver_classes.json `systems` names) or input kinds that can drive it (`from`) and be driven (`to`), or "any"; the interaction kinds it provides; whether it is an approximation (the edge must then say what it approximates); `order` driver_first when the driven solver reads the driver's baked output, so the driver is baked first; the Blender settings that carry it; and the evidence it works. bin/spec_audit.py checks every topology.solver_graph edge against this table; worldagent_measure.coupling finds the same channels in the built scene. Pairs with no entry: FLIP Fluids drives nothing (it reads Bullet, Cloth and Soft Body only as obstacles and passes no fluid state back); Bullet is driven only through force fields, the Fluid Flow field and keyed input (a rigid body world reads its collection, constraints, effector weights and point cache); two solvers never drive each other both ways, because one is always baked before the other (`no_channel` lists these). A coupling not listed is either a scripted_transfer (an approximation with method and assumptions) or a claim marked achievable: false.
no_channel: flip_fluids -> any system: FLIP Fluids 1.8.8 writes its own caches only; no Blender system reads its fluid state
any system -> bullet_rigid_body, except force_field, field_flow and kinematic_boundary: a rigid body world reads only its collection, constraints, effector_weights and point_cache
two-way between two solvers: one is baked before the other, so the earlier one cannot read the later one's result; list the reaction in omitted_reactions

channels.blender: Fluid modifier of type EFFECTOR on the body, effector_settings.use_effector, effector_type COLLISION or GUIDE; the body is in the domain's domain_settings.effector_group (None: every effector)
Fluid modifier of type FLOW on the body, flow_settings.use_inflow (and use_initial_velocity for a moving source); the body is in the domain's domain_settings.fluid_group (None: every flow)
flip_fluid.object_type TYPE_OBSTACLE on the body with flip_fluid.obstacle.export_animated_mesh True; without it FLIP exports a body that has no keyframes as a STATIC mesh at its first pose
Collision modifier on the body (collision.use); the body is in the cloth's collision_settings.collection or the soft body's settings.collision_collection (None: every collider)
Hook modifier on the cloth or soft body object whose object is the body, above the Cloth or Soft Body modifier
Keyed or driven transform, Armature, rigid_body.kinematic, or a keyed rigid body constraint value (motor, enabled, breaking threshold, spring) on a declared input object
Force field object (field.type); scene.rigidbody_world.effector_weights (collection, all, and the weight of the field's type). Bullet applies a field as a force at the centre of mass: no torque
Force field object; the target's effector_weights (ClothSettings, SoftBodySettings)
Force field object; the particle settings' effector_weights
Force field object; the domain's domain_settings.effector_weights

Force field of type FLUID_FLOW whose field.source_object is the Mantaflow domain, strength field.flow; scene.rigidbody_world.effector_weights.smokeflow > 0. It pushes the body with the baked grid velocity at its centre: no torque, no buoyancy, no reaction on the fluid
As field_flow to Bullet, with the cloth's settings.effector_weights.smokeflow > 0
A keyed switch both nodes share: emission frame, rigid_body.enabled or kinematic key, constraint enabled. No state passes between the solvers

evidence.ref: skills/scene-simulation/references/material-playbooks.en.md section 7 'share event timing ... do not call this two-way coupling'
